about: The home page's scoreboard: an illustration of one month on a client's Profit Record, labelled as one on the page, never a client's numbers. Each move is called before (expected) and measured after; scripts/site-blocks.mjs counts every dollar by the rules in scripts/blocks/attribution.html (never above the promise, nothing under $25, a miss stays at what it earned, a direct dollar counts what the platform paid), so the illustration cannot show a month the terms would not.

moves.move: Reorder moved up three weeks, ahead of the 271-day surcharge
Case pack re-spec'd to land under a weight edge
Low-inventory fee avoided by splitting one shipment
Price raised 50 cents on one SKU
Ads stopped on search terms with no sales in sixty days
Claim filed for units lost in a fulfilment centre
Coupon removed on a SKU that sold the same without it
